reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Phoenix Heating always deliver high quality work efficiently, and are reliable and happy to give advice. On this occasion they serviced the boiler, installed TRVs on the radiators, replaced a leaking tap in the kitchen and also replaced the shower hose in the bathroom… I always use Phoenix and highly recommend them.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We moved house and needed the boiler serviced in our new home. I selected Kieran from Which? Trusted Traders and am pleased I did so. He came with a colleague. They were very personable and their work was professional and clean The cost was very reasonable and we would be happy to recommend him and to use him again.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: I recently had the pleasure of having a new boiler installed by Kieran and his helper Tom, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their service. After being without heating for over a week, Kieran went above and beyond to ensure the boiler was installed to an exceptionally high standard within just a few days…
items.label: Which? review
